prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a side impact at intersection in Pearland, Texas, and has wrist fracture. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1151; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Please state your full name for the record.
A: [Claimant Name].

Q: Thank you. Can you tell me where you were when the collision occurred?
A: I was driving through the intersection in Pearland, Texas, heading east on the main road. The light had been green for me as I approached.

Q: What happened next?
A: A vehicle coming from the cross street ran through its red light and hit the driver's side of my car. It was a side impact, right where my door is. I felt the whole car shove sideways.

Q: Were you able to avoid the other vehicle at all?
A: No. It came into the intersection too fast for me to react. I hit the brakes and gripped the steering wheel, but there was no time.

Q: Did you lose consciousness or hit your head?
A: I don't think so. I remember everything. My left arm got slammed against the door frame and the center console, and I tried to brace myself with my hand.

Q: Where did you feel pain or injury?
A: My left wrist. It swelled up almost immediately, and I couldn't move my fingers without sharp pain. I also have some soreness in my shoulder and ribs.

Q: Did you receive medical treatment?
A: Yes. The paramedics checked me at the scene, and then I was taken to the emergency room. They took X-rays and confirmed a fracture in my wrist. I've since seen an orthopedic specialist, and I have a splint and follow-up appointments scheduled.

Q: Did anyone witness the collision?
A: There was a pedestrian at the corner who I believe saw the other driver run the light. I don't have their contact information, but the police report may list witnesses.

Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add?
A: Only that I was following all traffic rules and did nothing to cause this. I'm still dealing with the pain and limited use of my hand, and I'm concerned about time off work.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the statement.
A: Thank you.
